stem: Anchorline Freight's network team wants an automatic email the moment this month's Direct Connect and Transit Gateway spend is on pace to exceed $18,000, with nobody checking a dashboard.

choices.text: Open Cost Explorer's forecast view for the current month
Create an AWS Budget with a forecasted-cost threshold and an email notification action
Schedule a daily Cost and Usage Report delivery to an S3 bucket
Activate cost allocation tags for the affected network resources across every linked account

rationale: AWS Budgets is built to notify automatically when actual or forecasted cost crosses a threshold. Cost Explorer's forecast view requires someone to open it. A scheduled Cost and Usage Report delivers raw line-item data with no built-in alert. Cost allocation tags attribute spend to a cost center but do not generate a threshold alert.
